about: Solo antique furniture restorer working from a small rented workshop

messages.subject: Stall confirmed: Saturday November 14
messages.body:
Dear Inés,

Your stall at the Harlow Antiques Fair on Saturday November 14 is confirmed and paid. Setup from 7:00, doors open at 9:00. Please send us the size of the table you'll bring by November 10 so we can plan the floor.

Best wishes,
The Harlow Fair team

messages.subject: Cabinet delivery
messages.body: Hi Inés, great news that the cabinet is nearly done. We move house on Saturday the 14th of November, so could you deliver it to the new place the week of the 23rd? Address to follow. Oliver

messages.subject: Re: Cabinet delivery
messages.body: Hi Oliver, no problem. How about Tuesday November 24 in the morning? I'll bring it in my van. Good luck with the move! Inés

messages.subject: ¿Cenamos?
messages.body: ¡Hola guapa! ¿Cenamos el jueves en el sitio de tapas nuevo? Tengo mil cosas que contarte. Besos, Carmen

messages.subject: Re: ¿Cenamos?
messages.body: ¡Sí! El jueves a las ocho. Yo reservo. Besos

messages.subject: Six dining chairs
messages.body:
Hello Inés,

I'm an interior designer working on a townhouse renovation. The client has six mahogany dining chairs from the 1920s, finish worn and two with loose joints. Could you quote for refinishing all six? Photos attached.

Kind regards,
Carmen Ruiz
Ruiz Interiors

messages.subject: Re: Six dining chairs
messages.body:
Hello Carmen,

Thanks for the photos. Regluing the two loose chairs and a French polish on all six: 1,380 in total, about four weeks. Happy to look at them in person first.

Best,
Inés

messages.subject: Your order: blonde shellac flakes
messages.body: Hi Inés, sorry, the blonde shellac flakes are on backorder. We expect a new batch in about a week and will ship as soon as it lands. Simon, Lacquer & Co

messages.subject: Sideboard?
messages.body: Hi Inés, any news on the sideboard? No pressure, just excited! Priscilla

messages.subject: Re: Sideboard?
messages.body: Hi Priscilla, the repairs are done, I'm just waiting on shellac for the final coats. About ten more days. Inés

messages.subject: Re: Your order: blonde shellac flakes
messages.body: Good news, the shellac is back in stock and your order shipped this morning. Simon

messages.subject: Re: Sideboard?
messages.body: It's home and it looks beautiful. Thank you so much, worth every day of waiting! Payment sent. Priscilla

messages.subject: Rocking chair restoration
messages.body: Dear Inés, I have an old bentwood rocking chair with a split rocker and the cane seat is gone. Is it worth restoring? I'd like to keep it for sentimental reasons. Hamid

messages.subject: Re: Rocking chair restoration
messages.body: Dear Hamid, definitely worth it. A new rocker section, steam-bent, and a new cane seat: around 520. Bring it by any weekday. Inés

messages.subject: Grandma's chair
messages.body: Hi Ines, remember Grandma's rocking chair? It's been in my attic and one arm came off when we moved it. Any chance you could fix it some time? No rush at all. Lola x

messages.subject: Autumn issue: walnut veneer prices climb
messages.body: In this issue: why walnut veneer prices are up again, sharpening card scrapers, and a reader's Georgian bureau rescue.

messages.subject: Price update: walnut and burr veneers
messages.body: Due to short supply, walnut and burr veneer prices rise from December. Order now at current prices.

messages.subject: Share a stall?
messages.body: Hi Inés! Fancy sharing a stall at the Harvest Craft Market on Saturday October 31? My pots and your small pieces would look great together, and we'd split the fee. Tess

messages.subject: Re: Share a stall?
messages.body: Hi Tess, lovely idea. Let me see if I have enough small pieces ready and I'll let you know. Inés

messages.subject: Last call: stalls for Saturday October 31
messages.body: Dear maker, a few stalls are still free for the Harvest Craft Market on Saturday October 31. Book and pay by October 28 to secure yours.

messages.subject: Chest of drawers
messages.body:
Dear Ms Calderón,

I have a Victorian pine chest of drawers that was painted at some point. I'd love it stripped and waxed. Two drawers also stick badly. What would that cost?

Kind regards,
Margaret Ellis

messages.subject: Re: Chest of drawers
messages.body: Dear Margaret, stripping, waxing and easing the runners: 640, about three weeks. I can collect it if that helps. Best, Inés

messages.subject: Re: Chest of drawers
messages.body: Lovely, please go ahead, and yes, collection would be wonderful. Any morning next week. Margaret

messages.subject: Your workshop policy renews October 1
messages.body: Dear Ms Calderón, your workshop and goods-in-trust policy renews on October 1 at 412 a year. Please confirm that the value of customer items in your care is still under 20,000.

messages.subject: Re: Your workshop policy renews October 1
messages.body: Confirmed, still under 20,000. Please renew. Inés Calderón

messages.subject: Picking up the desk
messages.body: Hi Inés, can I pick up the writing desk on Saturday? I'll bring blankets and a friend. Ben

messages.subject: Re: Picking up the desk
messages.body: Saturday is fine, I'm at the workshop from 10 to 1. Inés

messages.subject: Receipts for the half-year
messages.body: Hi Inés, for the half-year figures could you send me the receipts for materials and the van fuel from April to September? A photo of each is fine. Pam

messages.subject: Re: Receipts for the half-year
messages.body: Hi Pam, all photos attached, sorry for the mess of a shoebox. Inés

messages.subject: El huerto
messages.body: Hola hija, este año los tomates han salido enormes. Tu padre dice que te mande fotos. ¿Cómo va el taller? ¿Comes bien? Un beso, mamá

messages.subject: Re: El huerto
messages.body: ¡Qué tomates, mamá! El taller va bien, mucho trabajo. Sí, como bien, te lo prometo. Besos a papá.

messages.subject: Re: El huerto
messages.body: Me alegro mucho. Llámanos el domingo si puedes. Te queremos.

messages.subject: Cuánto tiempo
messages.body: ¡Inés! He visto en redes la cómoda que restauraste, impresionante. ¿Cómo estás? Aquí seguimos, con el bebé que no duerme. Un abrazo, Javi

messages.subject: Re: Cuánto tiempo
messages.body: ¡Javi! Gracias. Todo bien por aquí. Mucho ánimo con el bebé, ya dormirá. Un abrazo grande.

messages.subject: Thank you
messages.body: Dear Inés, the mirror frame looks just as it did in my grandmother's hallway. I left you a review online. Thank you! Lucy

messages.subject: Talk in January?
messages.body: Dear Inés, would you give an evening talk at the museum in January on caring for old furniture at home? We offer a fee of 150. Fiona Grey, Town Craft Museum

messages.subject: Re: Talk in January?
messages.body: Dear Fiona, I'd be glad to. Any Thursday in January suits me. Inés

messages.subject: Quote: wardrobe delivery
messages.body: Dear Ms Calderón, our quote for collecting a large wardrobe from your workshop and delivering it to the Foster residence on Thursday November 12: 180, two movers, blankets included. Please confirm to book.

messages.subject: Re: Quote: wardrobe delivery
messages.body: Confirmed for Thursday November 12, please. The wardrobe will be ready from 8:00. Inés Calderón

messages.subject: hike?
messages.body: Hike on Sunday the 15th if the weather holds? The ridge loop, picnic at the top. Nora

messages.subject: Re: hike?
messages.body: Yes please! I'll bring the thermos.

messages.subject: Your appointment
messages.body: Dear Ms Calderón, we have you down for a checkup on Wednesday November 18 at 9:30. Please reply to confirm or reschedule.

messages.subject: Is this chair worth saving?
messages.body: Hi Inés, found this oak hall chair at a house clearance, photos attached. One leg is cracked and there's woodworm. Worth restoring or firewood? Daniel

messages.subject: Re: Is this chair worth saving?
messages.body: Hi Daniel, it's a nice one, not firewood! The worm looks old. Treatment plus a new leg section is about 260. Inés

messages.subject: Bins in the yard
messages.body: Hi Inés, the shared skip in the yard keeps overflowing. Shall we ask the landlord for a second one and split the cost? Greg (unit 3)

messages.subject: Paid
messages.body: Hi Inés, just paid the invoice for the table. We love it. Gwen

messages.subject: Work experience?
messages.body: Dear Ms Calderón, I'm studying furniture making and need two weeks of work experience in spring. Could I help in your workshop? Amir

messages.subject: Re: Work experience?
messages.body: Hi Amir, yes, two weeks in April would work. Send me your dates when your school confirms. Inés

messages.subject: Visita
messages.body: ¡Hermanita! Tengo una reunión de trabajo cerca de tu casa. Llego el sábado 21 de noviembre, ¿me puedo quedar una noche? Pablo

messages.subject: Re: Visita
messages.body: ¡Claro que sí! Te preparo el sofá. Hasta el 21.

messages.subject: Clamp sale
messages.body: All bar clamps 25% off this weekend only.

messages.subject: Your statement is ready
messages.body: Your business account statement for August is ready.

messages.subject: New this week
messages.body: New documentaries and series added this week.

promises.what: deliver the cabinet on Tuesday November 24 in the morning
book the tapas place for Thursday at eight
ship the shellac as soon as the batch lands
finish the sideboard in about ten days
let her know about sharing the stall
collect the chest of drawers next week
give a talk at the museum on a Thursday in January

traps.what: The antique fair stall and Oliver's house move are both on November 14; the delivery is set for the 24th, so nothing clashes.
Carmen Ruiz the friend and Carmen Ruiz the interior designer are different people.
The shellac backorder delayed Priscilla's sideboard, but the shellac shipped and she has it home.
A client's rocking chair (work) and Grandma's rocking chair for her sister (personal) must not be combined.
The walnut veneer price rise appears only in two newsletters.
Tess's shared stall and the market's last call are both for October 31, already past.
